# Dart Tutorial

> Free Dart tutorial for beginners. Learn Dart programming online from basics to advanced with easy examples, coding practice and an online Dart compiler.

Free, beginner-friendly lessons in simple English by Santosh Adhikari (CoderSantoshAdhikari). Every lesson has short runnable examples with output, and an exercise. No sign-up.
Contact: santosh.ad215@gmail.com

## Getting Started with Dart

- [What Is Dart? An Introduction to the Dart Language](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/what-is-dart/): Dart is a typed, object-oriented language from Google used to build mobile, web, desktop and server apps. Learn what it is and why people use it.
- [How to Install Dart on Windows, macOS and Linux](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/install-dart/): Step-by-step guide to installing the Dart SDK on Windows, macOS and Linux, checking the version, and setting up VS Code.
- [Your First Dart Program: Hello World Explained](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/first-dart-program/): Write Hello World in Dart and understand every part of it: the main function, print, statements, semicolons and how to run the file.
- [Comments in Dart: Single-Line, Multi-Line and Doc Comments](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/comments/): Learn the three kinds of comments in Dart, when to use each, and how documentation comments turn into API docs.
- [Dart Syntax: The Basic Rules of Dart in One Page](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/dart-syntax/): Learn Dart syntax fast: program structure, semicolons, variables, types, strings, if else, loops, functions, classes and null safety, with easy examples.
- [Dart vs JavaScript: Key Differences Explained with Code](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/dart-vs-javascript/): Dart vs JavaScript compared side by side: types, null safety, variables, strings, classes, async await, performance and when to choose each. Easy examples.
- [Dart vs Python: Differences, Code Comparison and Which to Learn](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/getting-started/dart-vs-python/): Dart vs Python compared with side-by-side code: syntax, types, null safety, lists, classes, async, speed and jobs. Find out which language to learn first.

## Dart Basics

- [Variables in Dart: var, Explicit Types and dynamic](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/variables/): Learn how to declare variables in Dart with var and explicit types, how type inference works, and the rules for naming them.
- [Data Types in Dart: A Complete Overview](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/data-types/): A tour of Dart's built-in data types: int, double, String, bool, List, Set, Map, Record, Null, Object and dynamic, with examples.
- [Numbers in Dart: int, double and num](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/numbers/): Work with int, double and num in Dart: arithmetic, integer division, rounding, parsing text into numbers and the dart:math library.
- [Strings in Dart: Interpolation, Methods and Multi-Line Text](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/strings/): Create and work with strings in Dart: quotes, interpolation, multi-line and raw strings, common methods, and StringBuffer.
- [Dart String Methods: Complete List with Easy Examples](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/string-methods/): Every common Dart string method with a short, runnable example: trim, toUpperCase, contains, substring, split, replaceAll, padLeft, parse and more.
- [Booleans in Dart: true, false and Logical Operators](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/booleans/): Understand the bool type in Dart, comparison results, and how to combine conditions with the and, or and not operators.
- [Operators in Dart: Arithmetic, Comparison, Logical and More](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/operators/): Every operator in Dart explained with examples: arithmetic, assignment, comparison, logical, type test, cascade and null-aware.
- [final vs const in Dart: Values That Do Not Change](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/final-and-const/): Learn the difference between final and const in Dart, when each is set, and why constant values make code safer and faster.
- [Type Conversion in Dart: Converting Between Types](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/type-conversion/): Convert between String, int, double, bool and collections in Dart using parse, tryParse, toString, toInt and friends.
- [Reading User Input in Dart with stdin](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/dart-basics/user-input/): Read text and numbers typed by the user in a Dart console program using stdin.readLineSync, with safe parsing and validation.

## Control Flow

- [if, else if and else in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/control-flow/if-else/): Learn conditional statements in Dart: if, else if, else, nested conditions and if-case, with clear examples and common mistakes.
- [The Ternary Operator in Dart (condition ? a : b)](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/control-flow/ternary-operator/): Use Dart's ternary operator to choose between two values in a single expression, and know when an if statement reads better.
- [switch and case in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/control-flow/switch-case/): Learn the switch statement in Dart: matching values, shared cases, default, guards with when, and how Dart 3 removed the need for break.
- [Loops in Dart: for, for-in, while and do-while](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/control-flow/loops/): Repeat code in Dart with for, for-in, while and do-while loops and forEach. Learn which loop to pick and how to avoid infinite loops.
- [break and continue in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/control-flow/break-and-continue/): Use break to leave a loop early and continue to skip one round. Includes labels for controlling nested loops in Dart.
- [assert in Dart: Catching Mistakes During Development](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/control-flow/assert/): Learn how assert statements work in Dart, when they run, and how to use them to catch programming mistakes early.

## Functions

- [Functions in Dart: Defining, Calling and Returning Values](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/functions/): Learn how to define and call functions in Dart, pass arguments, return values, and understand void, scope and local functions.
- [Function Parameters in Dart: Positional, Named, Optional and Default](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/function-parameters/): Master Dart function parameters: required positional, optional positional, named parameters, the required keyword and default values.
- [Arrow Functions in Dart (=> Syntax)](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/arrow-functions/): Write short functions in Dart with the arrow syntax. Learn what => means, where it can be used and where a block body is needed.
- [Anonymous Functions and Closures in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/anonymous-functions-and-closures/): Understand anonymous functions (lambdas) in Dart, how to store functions in variables, and how closures remember values.
- [Higher-Order Functions in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/higher-order-functions/): Learn higher-order functions in Dart: functions that take or return other functions, with map, where, reduce, fold and your own examples.
- [Recursion in Dart: Functions That Call Themselves](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/recursion/): Learn recursion in Dart with factorial, Fibonacci and sum examples. Understand base cases, the call stack and when to use a loop instead.
- [typedef in Dart: Naming Function and Other Types](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/functions/typedef/): Use typedef in Dart to give long function types and generic types a short, readable name. Includes practical callback examples.

## Collections

- [Dart Collections: List, Set and Map Overview](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/collections-overview/): An overview of collections in Dart. Compare List, Set and Map, learn collection literals and generics, and choose the right one.
- [Lists in Dart: Create, Access, Add, Remove and Sort](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/lists/): Complete guide to List in Dart: creating lists, indexing, adding and removing items, searching, sorting, sublists and fixed-length lists.
- [Dart List Methods: Complete Guide with Easy Examples](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/list-methods/): All the Dart list methods you need, with runnable examples: add, insert, remove, contains, indexOf, where, map, reduce, fold, sort, sublist, toSet and more.
- [Sets in Dart: Unique Collections and Set Operations](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/sets/): Learn Set in Dart: storing unique values, fast lookups, and set operations such as union, intersection and difference.
- [Maps in Dart: Key-Value Pairs Explained](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/maps/): Learn Map in Dart: create key-value pairs, read, add, update and remove entries, loop over a map, and handle missing keys safely.
- [MapEntry in Dart: Working with Map Entries](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/map-entries/): Use MapEntry and the entries property in Dart to sort, filter, transform and rebuild maps with fromEntries and map.
- [Iterable in Dart: Lazy Sequences Explained](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/iterables/): Understand Iterable in Dart, the parent of List and Set. Learn lazy evaluation, take, skip, firstWhere and when to call toList.
- [where, map, reduce and fold in Dart: Filter and Transform Collections](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/where-map-reduce/): Filter, transform and summarize collections in Dart with where, map, expand, reduce, fold, any and every, with practical examples.
- [Spread Operator, Collection if and Collection for in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/spread-and-collection-if/): Build lists, sets and maps in Dart using the spread operator (...), null-aware spread, collection if and collection for.
- [Queue in Dart: Adding and Removing from Both Ends](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/queue/): Learn the Queue class from dart:collection. Add and remove items at both ends efficiently, and build FIFO queues and stacks.
- [Collection Performance in Dart: Choosing the Fastest Structure](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/collections/collection-performance/): Understand the speed of common List, Set and Map operations in Dart, and learn practical tips for writing faster collection code.

## Null Safety

- [Null Safety in Dart: Nullable and Non-Nullable Types](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/null-safety/null-safety-in-dart/): Learn sound null safety in Dart: what null is, nullable types with ?, type promotion, and how the compiler prevents null errors.
- [Null-Aware Operators in Dart: ?., ??, ??= and !](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/null-safety/null-aware-operators/): Learn Dart's null-aware operators with examples: safe access with ?., default values with ??, assign-if-null with ??= and the ! assertion.
- [The late Keyword in Dart: Late and Lazy Initialization](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/null-safety/late-variables/): Learn when and how to use the late keyword in Dart for variables initialized after declaration, and for lazy initialization.

## Object-Oriented Programming

- [Classes and Objects in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/classes-and-objects/): Learn object-oriented basics in Dart: define a class, create objects, and use fields, methods, this and toString with clear examples.
- [Constructors in Dart: Default, Named, Initializer Lists and Redirecting](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/constructors/): Every kind of generative constructor in Dart: default, initializing formals, named parameters, named constructors and initializer lists.
- [Factory Constructors in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/factory-constructors/): Learn what a factory constructor is in Dart and when to use one: caching, singletons, returning subtypes and creating objects from JSON.
- [Const Constructors in Dart: Immutable Objects](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/const-constructors/): Learn const constructors in Dart: create immutable, compile-time constant objects, understand canonicalization and why Flutter uses const.
- [Getters and Setters in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/getters-and-setters/): Learn getters and setters in Dart: computed properties, validating values, private fields, lazy getters and best practices.
- [Private Members and Encapsulation in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/private-members/): Dart has no private keyword. Learn how the underscore makes members library-private, how privacy works across files, and best practices.
- [Static Variables and Methods in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/static-members/): Learn static members in Dart: static fields, static methods, constants, lazy initialization, and when to use them instead of instances.
- [Inheritance in Dart: extends, super and @override](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/inheritance/): Learn inheritance in Dart: create subclasses with extends, call the parent with super, override methods and pass constructor arguments.
- [Abstract Classes and Methods in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/abstract-classes/): Learn abstract classes in Dart: define methods without a body, force subclasses to implement them, and share common code.
- [Interfaces in Dart: The implements Keyword](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/interfaces/): Dart has no interface keyword for declarations: every class is an interface. Learn implements, multiple interfaces and when to use them.
- [Mixins in Dart: Reusing Code with the with Keyword](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/mixins/): Learn mixins in Dart: share methods between unrelated classes using mixin and with, restrict them with on, and understand ordering.
- [Polymorphism in Dart: One Interface, Many Forms](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/polymorphism/): Understand polymorphism in Dart with examples: method overriding, dynamic dispatch, interface-based polymorphism and type checks.
- [Enums in Dart: Simple and Enhanced Enumerations](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/enums/): Learn enums in Dart: define a fixed set of values, use them in switch, and add fields, methods and constructors with enhanced enums.
- [Extension Methods in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/extension-methods/): Add new methods and getters to existing types in Dart with extensions, including String, int, List and nullable types.
- [Extension Types in Dart: Zero-Cost Wrappers](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/extension-types/): Learn extension types in Dart: wrap an existing type in a new, distinct type with no run-time cost for safer IDs, units and APIs.
- [Generics in Dart: Type-Safe Reusable Code](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/generics/): Learn generics in Dart: generic classes, functions and constraints with extends, plus covariance and the covariant keyword.
- [Object Equality in Dart: ==, hashCode and identical](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/equality-and-hashcode/): Learn how equality works in Dart: identity versus value equality, overriding == and hashCode correctly, and why it matters for Set and Map.
- [Class Modifiers in Dart 3: base, interface, final, sealed and mixin](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/class-modifiers/): Understand Dart 3 class modifiers. Learn what abstract, base, interface, final, sealed and mixin allow and when to use each one.
- [Operator Overloading and Callable Classes in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/operator-overloading/): Define how operators such as +, -, ==, [] and < work on your own classes in Dart, and make objects callable with the call method.
- [Immutable Classes and copyWith in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/object-oriented-programming/immutability-and-copywith/): Write immutable Dart classes: final fields, const constructors, unmodifiable lists, the copyWith pattern, value equality, and when to use records or freezed.

## Records and Patterns

- [Records in Dart: Return Multiple Values Without a Class](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/records-and-patterns/records/): Learn Dart records: positional and named fields, record types, returning multiple values from a function, equality and destructuring.
- [Patterns and Destructuring in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/records-and-patterns/patterns/): Learn pattern matching in Dart 3: destructure lists, maps, records and objects, and use patterns in variables, if-case, for loops and switch.
- [Switch Expressions in Dart 3](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/records-and-patterns/switch-expressions/): Learn switch expressions in Dart: return a value from switch, match patterns and records, use guards, and get exhaustiveness checking.
- [Sealed Classes in Dart: Exhaustive Type Hierarchies](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/records-and-patterns/sealed-classes/): Learn sealed classes in Dart 3: model a fixed set of subtypes, get exhaustive switch checking, and represent state and results safely.

## Error Handling

- [Exception Handling in Dart: try, catch, on and finally](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/error-handling/exceptions/): Learn exception handling in Dart: throw, try, catch, on, finally and rethrow, the difference between Exception and Error, and best practices.
- [Custom Exceptions in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/error-handling/custom-exceptions/): Create your own exception classes in Dart by implementing Exception. Add fields, build exception hierarchies and handle them with on.

## Asynchronous Programming

- [Asynchronous Programming in Dart: An Introduction](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/asynchronous-programming/): Understand synchronous versus asynchronous code in Dart, why apps need async, and how Future, async, await and Stream fit together.
- [Future in Dart: Working with Values That Arrive Later](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/futures/): Learn the Future class in Dart: states of a future, then, catchError, whenComplete, Future.value, Future.delayed and chaining futures.
- [async and await in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/async-await/): Learn how async and await work in Dart: write asynchronous code that reads like normal code, return futures, and avoid common mistakes.
- [Error Handling in Asynchronous Dart Code](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/async-error-handling/): Handle errors in async Dart code with try and catch, catchError, timeouts and retries, and avoid unhandled future errors.
- [Streams in Dart: Handling a Sequence of Async Events](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/streams/): Learn Stream in Dart: listen to events over time, use await for, create streams with async* and StreamController, and transform them.
- [Single-Subscription vs Broadcast Streams in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/stream-types/): Understand the two kinds of stream in Dart: single-subscription and broadcast. Learn the differences, when to use each and how to convert.
- [Running Futures in Parallel in Dart: Future.wait and More](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/parallel-futures/): Run several async operations at once in Dart with Future.wait, record wait, Future.any and batching, and handle their errors.
- [Completer in Dart: Creating Futures You Complete Yourself](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/completer/): Learn how to use Completer in Dart to build a Future by hand, wrap callback-based APIs, and complete with a value or an error.
- [The Dart Event Loop: Microtasks and Events Explained](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/event-loop/): Understand how Dart runs asynchronous code on one thread: the event loop, event queue, microtask queue, and the order code executes.
- [Isolates in Dart: Running Code in Parallel](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/isolates/): Learn isolates in Dart: run heavy work on another CPU core with Isolate.run, pass messages with ports, and keep your app responsive.
- [Generators in Dart: sync*, async*, yield and yield*](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/generators/): Learn generator functions in Dart: produce values lazily with sync* and async*, use yield and yield*, and build infinite sequences.
- [Best Practices for Asynchronous Programming in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/async/async-best-practices/): A practical checklist for async Dart: await correctly, run work in parallel, handle errors, cancel subscriptions and avoid common pitfalls.

## Files and Directories

- [Reading Files in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/reading-files/): Learn how to read files in Dart with dart:io: whole file as text, line by line, as bytes, as a stream, and sync versus async methods.
- [Writing Files in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/writing-files/): Learn how to write files in Dart: create and overwrite with writeAsString, append, write bytes, and write large files with IOSink.
- [Checking If a File Exists and Deleting Files in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/checking-and-deleting-files/): Learn to check whether a file or directory exists in Dart, and to delete, rename, move and copy files safely with dart:io.
- [Working with Directories in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/directories/): Learn directory handling in Dart: create, list, search, copy and delete folders, and find the current and temporary directories.
- [File Paths in Dart with the path Package](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/file-paths/): Learn to build and manipulate file paths in Dart safely across Windows, macOS and Linux using the path package: join, basename and more.
- [File Attributes and Metadata in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/file-metadata/): Read file attributes in Dart: size, last modified and accessed times, type and permissions, using length, lastModified and stat.
- [Handling File Errors in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/files-and-io/file-error-handling/): Handle file system errors in Dart: FileSystemException, missing files, permission problems, and writing reliable file code.

## Libraries and Packages

- [Imports in Dart: import, as, show and hide](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/libraries-and-packages/imports/): Learn how to import libraries in Dart: core libraries, packages and your own files, with prefixes (as) and the show and hide keywords.
- [Creating Your Own Libraries in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/libraries-and-packages/creating-libraries/): Learn to organize Dart code into libraries: split files, structure the lib folder, use export to build a public API, and keep details private.
- [Using Packages from pub.dev in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/libraries-and-packages/pub-packages/): Learn to find, add, use and update Dart packages from pub.dev: pubspec.yaml, dart pub add, version constraints and pubspec.lock.
- [Creating and Publishing a Dart Package](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/libraries-and-packages/publishing-packages/): Step-by-step guide to creating a Dart package and publishing it on pub.dev: structure, pubspec, docs, tests, versioning and dart pub publish.

## Practical Dart

- [Working with JSON in Dart: Encode, Decode and Model Classes](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/json/): Learn JSON in Dart: jsonDecode and jsonEncode, converting to and from model classes with fromJson and toJson, lists and nested objects.
- [HTTP Requests in Dart: GET, POST and Calling REST APIs](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/http-requests/): Learn to call web APIs in Dart with the http package: GET and POST requests, headers, JSON bodies, status codes, errors and timeouts.
- [Date and Time in Dart: DateTime and Duration](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/date-and-time/): Work with dates and times in Dart: create, parse, format, compare and calculate with DateTime and Duration, including UTC and time zones.
- [Regular Expressions in Dart with RegExp](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/regular-expressions/): Learn RegExp in Dart: test, find, extract and replace text with patterns, use groups and named groups, and validate input.
- [Building Command-Line Apps in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/command-line-apps/): Build command-line tools in Dart: read arguments and options with the args package, use stdin, stdout and exit codes, and compile to an executable.
- [Unit Testing in Dart with package:test](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/testing/): Learn unit testing in Dart: write tests with test and expect, group them, use matchers, test async code and exceptions, and run dart test.
- [Math and Random Numbers in Dart: dart:math, Random, Rounding](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/math-and-random-numbers/): Use dart:math in Dart: random numbers with Random, nextInt and Random.secure, shuffle, min, max, sqrt, pow, pi, and rounding with round, floor, ceil and clamp.
- [Build a REST API in Dart with Shelf: Routes, JSON and Middleware](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/practical-dart/web-server-with-shelf/): Build a Dart back end with the shelf package: create a server, add routes with shelf_router, read and return JSON, use middleware, and deploy it.

## Tools and Performance

- [Formatting and Linting Dart Code: dart format and dart analyze](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/tools-and-performance/formatting-and-linting/): Keep Dart code clean with dart format, dart analyze, lints and dart fix. Learn to configure analysis_options.yaml for your project.
- [Debugging Dart Code: Breakpoints and Dart DevTools](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/tools-and-performance/debugging-and-devtools/): Learn to debug Dart with breakpoints, stepping, watches and the call stack in VS Code, and explore Dart DevTools for deeper inspection.
- [Logging in Dart: print, dart:developer and the logging Package](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/tools-and-performance/logging/): Learn logging in Dart: when print is enough, structured logs with dart:developer, and levels, loggers and handlers with package:logging.
- [Memory Management and Garbage Collection in Dart](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/tools-and-performance/memory-and-garbage-collection/): Understand how Dart manages memory: the generational garbage collector, what causes memory leaks, and how to find and prevent them.
- [const and Performance in Dart: Compile-Time Constants](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/tools-and-performance/const-and-performance/): Learn how const objects and compile-time constants improve Dart performance and memory use, and when const is and is not possible.
- [Benchmarking and Profiling Dart Code](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/tools-and-performance/benchmarking/): Measure Dart performance correctly: Stopwatch, warm-up, JIT versus AOT, benchmark_harness, the DevTools CPU profiler and common optimizations.

## Dart Next Steps

- [Dart Programming Examples: 30 Simple Programs with Output](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/dart-programming-examples/): 30 easy Dart programming examples for beginners with code and output: hello world, even odd, factorial, Fibonacci, primes, palindrome, classes and async.
- [Dart Practice Projects and Exercises for Beginners](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/practice-projects/): Fifteen Dart project ideas from beginner to advanced, with the skills each one practises, to turn what you have learned into real ability.
- [Dart Interview Questions and Answers](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/dart-interview-questions/): Forty common Dart interview questions with clear answers, covering basics, null safety, OOP, async, collections and Dart 3 features.
- [Dart Cheat Sheet: Syntax Quick Reference](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/dart-cheat-sheet/): A one-page Dart cheat sheet: variables, strings, collections, control flow, functions, classes, null safety, async and Dart 3 syntax.
- [Common Dart Errors and How to Fix Them: A Troubleshooting Guide](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/common-dart-errors/): Fix the most common Dart errors fast: null check errors, LateInitializationError, RangeError, FormatException, type errors, Bad state and pub errors.
- [Dart Glossary: Programming Terms Explained in Simple Words](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/dart-glossary/): A simple A to Z Dart glossary: async, class, closure, const, Future, generics, mixin, null safety, record, Stream, widget and more, each linked to a lesson.
- [What's New in Dart 3: Modern Features from 3.0 to 3.10](https://www.dart-tutorial.dev/next-steps/whats-new-in-dart-3/): Modern Dart features with examples: records, patterns, sealed classes, extension types, digit separators, wildcards, null-aware elements and dot shorthands.
